                         OFFICE OF PUBLIC UTILITY COUNSEL'S
                           NOTICE OF CHANGE OF COUNSEL

       Pursuant to 16 Tex. Admin. Code § 22.101(b), the Office of Public Utility Counsel (OPUC)

notifies the Public Utility Commission of Texas, the State Office of Administrative Hearings, and

all parties to this proceeding that Chris Ekoh has been removed as an attorney of record for OPUC

in this docket. Kourtnee Jinks remains as lead counsel in this matter. Please direct all future filings

and communications to the undersigned attorneys.


Date: September 24, 2026
